_comment: Recognition Trials: what a bearer must do with a law before its Instrument will wake. clause is the id of a clause of that law; COUNT counts the times it fires, SUM adds the amounts.

threshold.gatekeeper.text: Have your line deny five crossings.

threshold.divide.text: Have the Divide refuse four acts.

debt.creditor.text: Call in forty of what you are owed.

debt.debtor.text: Pay thirty of your debt forward.

reflection.twin.text: Have a twin suffer thirty for the other.

reflection.answer.text: Return three blows to their authors.
